|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/calderarighim.html</ref>

How could you not love a [[Talz]]? Especially one that is the little man's best friend! Just like the original [[Talz]] always stood up for those poor unfortunates who were the target of weapon fire, this unique furry pacifist doesn't like to see too much violence -- at least, not any initiated by your opponent.

So when the opponent has [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]], [[Maul]], the Emperor, or some other high-ability character with some scrub support, Caldera is your best friend for dropping down to calm the situation. This allows you to block the drain and avoid the beatdown. He will have to move someone away to fight you, and that's your cue to bring Qui-Gon in to even the score.

His card drawing text is just gravy! Great if you haven't quite got to that 5 you've been tracking. You want more? How about that he is a [[Talz]] representative for [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire{{!}}Agents In The Court]] ([[Jabba]]'s Palace Sealed Deck objective). Throw in a bunch of [[Talz]]'s to help him, and he won't ever feel the sting of a blaster or lightsaber! You want more? He is a common!

One word of warning -- beware of [[4-LOM With Concussion Rifle]]!
